queries: WITH t AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, spent, spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(spent) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.spent) AS avg_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_diff FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Customers are those with at least one invoice. Customers with no invoices are not counted in the average share across customers.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-customer shares, taken over all customers before filtering.

alternatives.interpretation: Every row in Customer counts, including customers with no invoices (total 0). This changes the number of customers and so the average share.

alternatives.interpretation: Include customers with no invoices as having a total of 0, which lowers the average share and changes which customers are above it.
